entries.title: Luke 7:1
segments: ¶Now when He concluded all His sayings in the hearing of the people, He entered Capernaum.

entries.title: Luke 7:2
segments: And a certain centurion's servant, who was dear to him, was sick and ready to die.

entries.title: Luke 7:3
segments: So when he heard about Jesus, he sent elders of the Jews to Him, pleading with Him to come and heal his servant.

entries.title: Luke 7:4
segments: And when they came to Jesus, they begged Him earnestly, saying that the one for whom He should do this was deserving,

entries.title: Luke 7:5
segments: "for he loves our nation, and has built us a synagogue."

entries.title: Luke 7:6
segments: Then Jesus went with them. And when He was already not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to Him, saying to Him, "Lord, do not trouble Yourself, for I am not worthy that You should enter under my roof.

entries.title: Luke 7:7
segments: "Therefore I did not even think myself worthy to come to You. But say the word, and my servant will be healed.

entries.title: Luke 7:8
segments: "For I also am a man placed under authority, having soldiers under me. And I say to one, 'Go,' and he goes; and to another, 'Come,' and he comes; and to my servant, 'Do this,' and he does [it]."

entries.title: Luke 7:9
segments: When Jesus heard these things, He marveled at him, and turned around and said to the crowd that followed Him, "I say to you, I have not found such great faith, not even in Israel!"

entries.title: Luke 7:10
segments: And those who were sent, returning to the house, found the servant well who had been sick.

entries.title: Luke 7:11
segments: ¶Now it happened, the day after, [that] He went into a city called Nain; and many of His disciples went with Him, and a large crowd.

entries.title: Luke 7:12
segments: And when He came near the gate of the city, behold, a dead man was being carried out, the only son of his mother; and she was a widow. And a large crowd from the city was with her.

entries.title: Luke 7:13
segments: When the Lord saw her, He had compassion on her and said to her, "Do not weep."

entries.title: Luke 7:14
segments: Then He came and touched the open coffin, and those who carried [him] stood still. And He said, "Young man, I say to you, arise."

entries.title: Luke 7:15
segments: So he who was dead sat up and began to speak. And He presented him to his mother.

entries.title: Luke 7:16
segments: Then fear came upon all, and they glorified God, saying, "A great prophet has risen up among us"; and, "God has visited His people."

entries.title: Luke 7:17
segments: And this report about Him went throughout all Judea and all the surrounding region.

entries.title: Luke 7:18
segments: Then the disciples of John reported to him concerning all these things.

entries.title: Luke 7:19
segments: ¶And John, calling two of his disciples to [him], sent [them] to Jesus, saying, "Are You the Coming One, or do we look for another?"

entries.title: Luke 7:20
segments: When the men had come to Him, they said, "John the Baptist has sent us to You, saying, 'Are You the Coming One, or do we look for another?'"

entries.title: Luke 7:21
segments: And that very hour He cured many of infirmities, afflictions, and evil spirits; and to many blind He gave sight.

entries.title: Luke 7:22
segments: Jesus answered and said to them, "Go and tell John the things you have seen and heard: that [the] blind see, [the] lame walk, [the] lepers are cleansed, [the]  deaf hear, [the] dead are raised, [the] poor have the gospel preached to them.

entries.title: Luke 7:23
segments: "And blessed is [he] who is not offended because of Me."

entries.title: Luke 7:24
segments: When the messengers of John had departed, He began to speak to the multitudes concerning John: "What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken by the wind?

entries.title: Luke 7:25
segments: "But what did you go out to see? A man clothed in soft garments? Indeed those who are gorgeously appareled and live in luxury are in kings' courts.

entries.title: Luke 7:26
segments: "But what did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I say to you, and more than a prophet.

entries.title: Luke 7:27
segments: "This is [he] of whom it is written: 'Behold, I send My messenger before Your face, Who will prepare Your way before You.'

entries.title: Luke 7:28
segments: "For I say to you, among those born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptist; but he who is least in the kingdom of God is greater than he."

entries.title: Luke 7:29
segments: And when all the people heard [Him], even the tax collectors justified God, having been baptized with the baptism of John.

entries.title: Luke 7:30
segments: But the Pharisees and lawyers rejected the will of God for themselves, not having been baptized by him.

entries.title: Luke 7:31
segments: And the Lord said, "To what then shall I liken the men of this generation, and what are they like?

entries.title: Luke 7:32
segments: "They are like children sitting in the marketplace and calling to one another, saying: 'We played the flute for you, And you did not dance; We mourned to you, And you did not weep.'

entries.title: Luke 7:33
segments: "For John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine, and you say, 'He has a demon.'

entries.title: Luke 7:34
segments: "The Son of Man has come eating and drinking, and you say, 'Look, a glutton and a winebibber, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!'

entries.title: Luke 7:35
segments: "But wisdom is justified by all her children."

entries.title: Luke 7:36
segments: ¶Then one of the Pharisees asked Him to eat with him. And He went to the Pharisee's house, and sat down to eat.

entries.title: Luke 7:37
segments: And behold, a woman in the city who was a sinner, when she knew that [Jesus] sat at the table in the Pharisee's house, brought an alabaster flask of fragrant oil,

entries.title: Luke 7:38
segments: and stood at His feet behind [Him] weeping; and she began to wash His feet with her tears, and wiped [them] with the hair of her head; and she kissed His feet and anointed [them] with the fragrant oil.

entries.title: Luke 7:39
segments: Now when the Pharisee who had invited Him saw [this], he spoke to himself, saying, "This man, if He were a prophet, would know who and what manner of woman [this is] who is touching Him, for she is a sinner."

entries.title: Luke 7:40
segments: And Jesus answered and said to him, "Simon, I have something to say to you." So he said, "Teacher, say it."

entries.title: Luke 7:41
segments: "There was a certain creditor who had two debtors. One owed five hundred denarii, and the other fifty.

entries.title: Luke 7:42
segments: "And when they had nothing with which to repay, he freely forgave them both. Tell Me, therefore, which of them will love him more?"

entries.title: Luke 7:43
segments: Simon answered and said, "I suppose the [one] whom he forgave more." And He said to him, "You have rightly judged."

entries.title: Luke 7:44
segments: Then He turned to the woman and said to Simon, "Do you see this woman? I entered your house; you gave Me no water for My feet, but she has washed My feet with her tears and wiped [them] with the hair of her head.

entries.title: Luke 7:45
segments: "You gave Me no kiss, but this woman has not ceased to kiss My feet since the time I came in.

entries.title: Luke 7:46
segments: "You did not anoint My head with oil, but this woman has anointed My feet with fragrant oil.

entries.title: Luke 7:47
segments: "Therefore I say to you, her sins, [which are] many, are forgiven, for she loved much. But to whom little is forgiven, [the same] loves little."

entries.title: Luke 7:48
segments: Then He said to her, "Your sins are forgiven."

entries.title: Luke 7:49
segments: And those who sat at the table with Him began to say to themselves, "Who is this who even forgives sins?"

entries.title: Luke 7:50
segments: Then He said to the woman, "Your faith has saved you. Go in peace."
